leadText:
Lapidarian Highlands (Japanese: ギプナ高地 Guipna Highlands) is an -exclusive location in the Pokémon world. It was mentioned in The Bonds of Evolution!. described it as "one of the last unexplored regions in the world."

Diantha was filming a movie in the Lapidarian Highlands when a thick fog rose, and she got lost from her crew. She had entrusted her manager, Kathi Lee, with her . As Diantha's crew went searching for her, Gardevoir came out of its . By connecting its heart with Diantha's, it was able to guide the crew to Diantha's location.
